title: Microsoft 365 admin center: rules that automate agent lifecycle management
summary: Hold: the user-access API note omits a required delegated workload permission on the Tenant Configuration Management service principal. An administrator following the listed permission requirements would not have everything needed to apply the setting. The lifecycle-rule licensing, admin paths and package operations are otherwise supported.
